restaurantName: Peter Pan Afternoon Tea at Aqua Shard
address: Level 31, The Shard, 31 St. Thomas Street, London,SE1 9RY
bio: Aqua Shard, located on Level 31 of The Shard, offers a contemporary British Afternoon Tea with breath-taking views of the London skyline.  Following a recent redesign aqua shard's new look restaurant, bar and private dining rooms are ready to welcome their first guests. Discover contemporary British menus, using the finest seasonal ingredients within western Europe's tallest building. This spectacular dining space has floor-to-ceiling glass windows offering 360-degree views of London.  The Peter Pan Afternoon Tea menu encompasses all of the magic of the classic children's fairy tale. Begin with a selection of delicious sandwiches and savouries including a 'Codfish' Captain Hook brandade and a ''Lost Boys' chicken and bacon sandwich. Then, tuck into freshly-baked vanilla and golden raisin scones, followed by a tempting sweet plate.  Peter Pan Afternoon Tea costs £70 per adult, £55 for children up to 12 years old.  Champagne Afternoon Tea is priced at £90 with a Glass of Pommery Brut Royal Champagne and £97 with a Glass of Veuve Clicquot Rosé Champagne
pageTitle: Peter Pan Afternoon Tea at Aqua Shard
